_comment: Which paths ship in a release, and who owns each one after install. managed = the release owns it (replaced on upgrade, verified by readback). seed = written once if absent, then yours forever. Anything excluded never ships; anything you create yourself is invisible to the installer. client_owned = paths that are the client's by contract and never part of any package (the settings override layer): the installer never writes, replaces, verifies or removes them, and a release build refuses a source that tracks one. seed_lines = one declared line a release adds once to a seed file that predates it (today: the operator core's import in CLAUDE.md); never twice, never into a deleted file, taken back by rollback.

render.why: CODEOWNERS must name owners who actually have access to THIS repository, so it is rendered per workspace, never copied.
